info.title: kritzeLLM API
info.summary: Search and chat with a handwritten journal.
info.description:
Upload photos of handwritten journal pages and review their transcriptions. Search and a chat agent
that cites the exact page are coming. 🖍️

## Conventions

- **Base path** `/api/v1`. JSON bodies use `camelCase`.
- **Timestamps** are RFC 3339 (`2026-10-10T09:30:00Z`); journal dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **IDs** are [TypeIDs](https://github.com/jetify-com/typeid): a type prefix plus a base32-encoded
  UUIDv7, e.g. `pg_01k7c9a3b5d7e9f1g3h5j7k9m1`. Prefixes: `jrn` journal, `pg` page, `blk` block,
  `job` job.
- **Errors** are [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `application/problem+json`.
  `400` means the request couldn't be parsed; `422` means a value is invalid (including malformed
  IDs) and lists each problem in `errors`. A well-formed ID that doesn't exist is a `404`.
- **Lists** use cursor pagination: pass `limit` and the previous response's `nextCursor` as
  `cursor`. `nextCursor` is `null` on the last page. Treat cursors as opaque strings; they stay
  valid even if the last item you got is deleted meanwhile.
- **Long-running work** (transcribing, re-indexing) answers `202 Accepted` with a `Job`
  and a `Location` header. Poll the job until it finishes.
- **Auth**: when the server has an `API_TOKEN` configured, every request except `GET /health`
  needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Deletes a journal with all of its pages, images, blocks and search index entries.

This can't be undone.

post.description:
Uploads page photos or scans into a journal.

Each file is turned upright and stored with a normalized JPEG and a thumbnail, then becomes a
page that's transcribed and indexed in the background. If any file isn't a supported image or
is too big, nothing is stored.

Uploads are idempotent per file: a file whose SHA-256 is already in this journal (or earlier
in the same upload) returns the existing page with `duplicate: true` and takes no page number,
so a failed upload can simply be sent again.

415.description: An uploaded file isn't a supported image type.

422.description: Some values are invalid (including malformed IDs). Each one is listed in `errors`.

get.description:
Returns the page image.

`normalized` (the default) is the rotated, resized JPEG that gets transcribed.
`original` is the uploaded file as-is, and `thumbnail` is a small JPEG preview. A page's images
never change, so they may be cached for good.

put.description:
Replaces the whole transcription of a page, in reading order.

Blocks sent with an `id` are updated in place (so existing chat sources keep working); blocks
without one are created; existing blocks that aren't sent are deleted. The page is re-indexed in
the background. Returns `409` while the page is waiting to be read or being read.

400.description: The request couldn't be parsed (e.g. malformed JSON or multipart).

409.description: The request conflicts with the current state (e.g. a job is still running).

422.description: Some values are invalid (including malformed IDs). Each one is listed in `errors`.

post.description:
Throws away the current blocks and reads the page again.

Manual edits are lost. Returns `409` while the page is already waiting to be read or being read.

Location.description: URL of the job to poll.

Corrects a block's text, kind or `uncertain` flag. Its page is re-indexed in the background.

Edits made in a row share one re-index job while it's still queued. Returns `409` while the page
is waiting to be read or being read.

PageStatus.title: PageStatus
PageStatus.description:
Where a page is in processing.

`uploaded` (waiting for the worker) → `transcribing` → `indexing` → `ready`.
`failed` means a step failed; see `error` and re-transcribe to retry.
